title: 第118章
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

这等政策显然是偏向于那些没有土地,或者田地甚少的贫民。

至于那些世家已经入口的肥肉，陛下吸收了圣德先帝的前车之鉴，并没有去动。

韩毅原本认为,这样来自世家的阻力会小一些。

可惜,朝堂上那些管东管西的爹们,岂能眼看着自己以后生财无望？一个个仿佛要被抄家一般，在朝堂上声泪俱下,痛陈这等忤逆祖宗章法的朝政，必定要给大魏带来祸事。

什么开垦荒田？山河龙脉，岂能让那些流民任意砍伐？

落云虽然身在东宫，可是也听说有人在朝堂上争吵个没完，就算到了退朝的时间，群臣们也没有散去。

据说还有两个老臣觉得新政一出,大魏朝便要完了，气得要在陛下前面撞柱明志。

可惜颤巍巍地还没跑几步,就被人拦下,然后那老臣顺势昏厥,被人用担架给抬出去的。

韩瑶也在落云的宫里，听着去打探太子何时下朝的宫人回禀,朝堂里如此乱哄哄的,韩瑶居然长舒了一口气。

她一边给嫂嫂剥着青桔的皮，一边感激涕零道：“我皇兄可真好！他不是知道了归北闯下了祸，这才赶着今日颁布新政,去招惹那帮老臣的吧？”

落云心里正替韩临风和公公捏了一把汗，听闻韩瑶这么说,都气乐了：“你皇兄现在一门心思都钻到田地里了,哪里能管人沾染了什么官司！你回去跟你家相公说好了,可不能这么贸然冲动行事了！”

说起来赵归北闯下的祸事，不算太大，可也不小。

就在这次大朝的前二日，赵归北闯入了竣国公府，将竣国公给打伤了。

竣国公的门生们义愤填膺，写了弹劾赵归北的奏折。可惜今日门生们的告状，都被撞柱老臣们的声音给淹没了。

赵归北这才侥幸逃过一场责罚。

其实这竣国公也挺冤枉的，人在府中坐，压根不知情况，就被冲过来的小将军打了两个乌眼青。

而赵归北如此冲动的原因，还得从渔阳中秋夜去冷宫探视王皇后说起。

那宫宴热闹非凡，可是渔阳却踏着清辉冷月，在太子的下人引领下去冷宫看望了母亲。

她之前几次想要看望母亲，可是都被挡在了宫外。这次母女想见，分外不易。

昔日风光无限的王皇后，如今已经凋零得老迈了许多，只一身粗布尼袍，独坐在空荡荡的屋内。

当她看到发丝也染上了白霜的女儿时，也是悲从中来，压抑着悲苦道：“渔阳……你是渔阳？怎么你的头发白了这么多？”

母女好不容易想见，本应有说不尽的千言万语。

可是听到渔阳跟那赵栋一样，开口便询问那慧娘的死因时，王皇后闭了闭眼，然后和缓道：“你过来，挨我近些……”

当渔阳凑过去时，王皇后突然狠狠给了她一巴掌：“你母亲沦入如此境地，你弟弟被囚也生死不明。你不思该如何解困，却还在想着那些狗屁的情爱？”

渔阳捂着被打的脸，低声道：“我已经跟赵栋和离，来问只是要弄个清楚……”

王皇后看着自己这没救的女儿，也是心灰意冷，只是开口道：“赵栋那个泥腿子，我半只眼都未曾瞧上过他。他若是个爱慕权势的，你非要嫁他也就算了，我左右能有法子叫他娶你。只要你是公主一日，他也会看在权势的情面上，对你照顾周全。可是我后来也看透了，他就是个榆木脑袋，不会审时度势，就算你嫁给了他，他又如何能对你好？这种货色，也配我去费心谋害他那个乡野老婆？你也是太看不起你母后了！”

她的女儿，何等金枝玉叶！偏却看不上世家的子弟！

王皇后当时拗不过女儿，又劝不动女儿嫁人，最后只能宽慰自己，就算女儿不嫁人，她是堂堂公主，可以恣意享乐一辈子。

总也好过她这个母后，虽然嫁给国君，却被困在一方宫池里，守着个不相爱的男人，再跟一群贱人无休止的勾心斗角。

可是后来，赵栋死了老婆，渔阳眼看着赵栋一蹶不振，非要眼巴巴地去给人当后妈。

她和魏惠帝劝阻不住，便破罐子破摔，任着她去了。

现在看着女儿如此下场，倒是印证了她那时的想法，嫁给个不爱自己的男人，何谈什么心愿了偿？只不过又一片渡不过的苦海罢了。

不过王皇后的脑子，都是在宫斗里浸染过的，只听女儿的哭诉后，那么一转，便想到了其中的关隘。

她冷笑连连道：“我与你父皇当时在行宫，急需人来支援，赵栋领兵前来，何等重要。我本以为他会向着自己的岳母，最不济，也应该前来护驾。可是这泼脏水落到我的身上，赵栋却差点被东平王当了马前卒。这证词人证俱全，看来是有人费心做局了……你和离了也好，不然你这身份，赵栋那小子也不会善待你。我这也不要再来了，远远离开京城这个是非之地吧！你若还当我是娘，就听为娘的最后一句话，此后余生，当为自己而活，你已四十不惑，两鬓染白，也该落地了，情爱和男人最是无用！”

渔阳听得悲从中来，想要抱着母亲再痛哭一场，却被王皇后一把给推开了，冷冷道：“你哪里像我的女儿，没有半点刚直之气！真是看了你都厌烦！还不快些滚出去，不要再来打扰我？”

母亲如此冷情，渔阳也只能拜别离去。

只是渔阳走后，王皇后这才看着女儿的背影，默默流下了一滴清泪。

她怎么能不想女儿呢？只是不说得狠绝些，她怕女儿还要惦记着来看她。

自己如今这废后的身份，挨得太近只怕迟早要受连累。那韩氏父子虽然答应了魏惠帝，要善待这一脉的子孙。可是前提也是懂夹着尾巴做人的道理。

她这一辈子，为了自己的一双儿女努力争抢，可是到头来，却是争得满盘皆输，何尝不是一种讽刺？

她如今能做的，就是在这间陋室里，敲着木鱼，默默祈祷上苍给她的儿女一条活路……

至于这对母女的对话，自然也被原本抄录，递到了韩临风那里。

毕竟探视废后，须得隔墙有人监听，监督言行，以免被有心人利用，传递了不好的消息，蓄谋颠覆朝纲。

只是韩临风看这记录的时候，赵归北也正在求他。

他这几日为了母亲的事情，简直都吃不下饭。

母亲一直都不肯见他，父亲又不肯说出缘由来。他便来央求韩临风，看看自己神通广大的大舅子，能不能替他想些法子出来。

Page (1/3)

Such policies are obviously biased towards poor people who have no land or very little land.

As for the fat meat that the aristocratic families had already imported, His Majesty learned from the mistakes of the late Emperor Shengde and did not touch it.

Han Yi originally thought that the resistance from the aristocratic family would be smaller.

It's a pity that those fathers in the court who are in charge of everything, how can they see that they have no hope of making money in the future?One by one, as if their homes were about to be confiscated, they burst into tears in the court hall, stating bitterly that such government affairs that were against the laws of their ancestors would definitely bring disaster to the Wei Dynasty.

What about reclaiming wasteland?How can the mountains, rivers and dragon veins be allowed to be cut down at will by the refugees?

Although Luoyun was in the East Palace, he heard that some people were quarreling in the court hall. Even when it was time to retreat, the ministers did not disperse.

It is said that there are two old ministers who feel that the Wei Dynasty will be over as soon as the New Deal comes out, and they are so angry that they want to make a statement in front of His Majesty.

Unfortunately, he was stopped before he could even run a few steps. The veteran fainted and was carried out on a stretcher.

Han Yao was also in Luoyun's palace, listening to the reports from the palace servants who went to find out when the prince would go to court. The court was so noisy that Han Yao breathed a sigh of relief.

While she was peeling the green oranges for her sister-in-law, she said with tears of gratitude: "My imperial brother is so kind! Didn't he know that Guibei got into trouble, so he rushed to promulgate the new policy today to provoke those old officials?"

Luo Yun was feeling worried for Han Linfeng and his father-in-law. Hearing what Han Yao said, he became angry and happy: "Your brother, the emperor, is so focused on getting into the fields now that you don't care what kind of lawsuits he gets involved in! You should go back and make an agreement with your husband-in-law, but you can't act so rashly and impulsively!"

Speaking of the disasters Zhao Guibei caused, they were not too big, but they were not small either.

Just two days before this great dynasty, Zhao Guibei broke into Duke Jun's mansion and injured Duke Jun.

The disciples of Duke Jun were filled with indignation and wrote a memorial to impeach Zhao Guibei.It's a pity that today's complaints from the disciples were drowned out by the voices of the veterans.

Zhao Guibei was lucky enough to escape punishment.

In fact, Duke Jun was quite unjustly accused. He was sitting in the mansion without knowing anything about the situation, but he was beaten black and blue by the young general who rushed over.

The reason why Zhao Guibei was so impulsive has to start with his visit to Queen Wang in the Leng Palace on the Mid-Autumn Festival Night in Yuyang.

The palace banquet was very lively, but Yuyang, under the bright cold moon, was led by the prince's servants to visit his mother in the cold palace.

She wanted to visit her mother several times before, but was blocked from the palace.It was extremely difficult for mother and daughter to meet each other this time.

The Queen Wang, who used to be so glorious in the past, has now become much old and withered. She only wears a coarse cloth robe, sitting alone in an empty house.

When she saw her daughter whose hair was also stained with white frost, she felt sad. She suppressed her sorrow and said, "Yuyang... are you Yuyang? Why is your hair so white?"

Mother and daughter finally imagined that there should be countless words to express.

But when she heard that Yuyang, like Zhao Dong, asked about the cause of Huiniang's death, Queen Wang closed her eyes, and then said gently: "Come here, get closer to me..."

When Yuyang came closer, Queen Wang suddenly slapped her hard: "Your mother has fallen into such a situation, and your brother is imprisoned and his life or death is unknown. You don't think about how to get out of trouble, but you are still thinking about those bullshit loves?"

Yuyang covered his beaten face and whispered: "I have reconciled with Zhao Dong. I came here just to find out..."

Queen Wang looked at her helpless daughter and was also disheartened. She just said: "I have never laid eyes on Zhao Dong, that mud-legged guy. If he loves power, you can forget it if you insist on marrying him. I can find ways to make him marry you. As long as you are a princess, he will do the same.For the sake of power, I have taken good care of you.But I later saw that he is a fool and cannot judge the situation. How can he treat you well even if you marry him?Is this kind of guy worthy of me trying to kill his country wife?You look down on your mother too much!"

What a golden child her daughter is!But he looks down on the children of aristocratic families!

Queen Wang could not persuade her daughter to get married at that time, and she could only comfort herself in the end. Even if her daughter did not get married, she was a royal princess and could enjoy herself as much as she wanted for the rest of her life.

It was better than her, a queen, who, although married to the king, was trapped in a palace, guarding a man she didn't love, and engaging in endless intrigues with a group of bitches.

But later, Zhao Dong's wife died, and Yuyang saw that Zhao Dong was in despair and insisted on becoming a stepmother.

Unable to dissuade her, she and Emperor Hui of Wei broke the jar and let her go.

Seeing her daughter end up like this now confirms her thoughts at that time. How can she fulfill her wish by marrying a man who doesn't love her?It’s just another sea of ​​suffering that cannot be crossed.

However, Queen Wang's brain had been immersed in palace battles. After listening to her daughter's cries, she suddenly thought of the hurdles involved.

She sneered and said: "Your father and I were in the palace at the time, and we were in urgent need of support. It was so important for Zhao Dong to lead the troops. I thought he would go to his mother-in-law, and at the worst, he should come to escort him. But this dirty water fell on me, and Zhao Dong was almost used as a pawn by King Dongping. This testimony is complete, and it seems that someone has taken the trouble to set up the game....It’s better to divorce, otherwise Zhao Dong will not treat you well.I don’t want to come here anymore, and stay away from this place of right and wrong!If you still treat me as your mother, you should listen to my mother’s last words. You should live for yourself for the rest of your life. You are already forty and your temples are turning white. It’s time to get married.Love and men are the most useless!”

Yuyang felt sad after hearing this and wanted to hug his mother and cry again, but Queen Wang pushed her away and said coldly: "You are nothing like my daughter, you don't have the slightest bit of uprightness! I'm really tired of looking at you! Why don't you get out quickly and stop disturbing me?"

His mother was so cold, so Yuyang could only say goodbye and leave.

It was only after Yuyang left that Queen Wang looked at her daughter's back and silently shed a drop of tears.

How could she not think about her daughter?But if she didn't say it harshly, she was afraid that her daughter would still miss her and come to see her.

With my current status as a crippled queen, I am afraid that I will be implicated sooner or later if I get too close.Although the Han family and his son had promised Emperor Wei Hui to treat the descendants of this lineage well.But the prerequisite is to understand how to behave with your tail between your legs.

All her life, she had worked hard to fight for her children, but in the end, she had lost everything. Isn't it an irony?

All she can do now is to knock on the wooden fish in this humble room and silently pray to God to give her children a way to survive...

As for the conversation between mother and daughter, it was naturally copied and sent to Han Linfeng.

After all, when visiting the deceased, someone must monitor the wall and supervise the words and deeds, so as not to be taken advantage of by those who are interested in passing on bad news and plotting to subvert the imperial court.

But when Han Linfeng read this record, Zhao Guibei was also begging him.

He couldn't eat at all these days because of his mother's affairs.

His mother refused to see him, and his father refused to tell him why.He came to beg Han Linfeng to see if his brother-in-law, who had great supernatural powers, could think of something for him.
